about: The repositories whose merges Alex alone decides, which the merge controller may merge (uor-merge-admission: repository is owned), and the paths each pull request is read against. Every other repository is shared: there the controller merges only an agent's pull request (agents), on the gate the shared entry names, and never a person's. This file is a gate: adding a repository here needs a human (AUTOMATION.md H3).

owned.why: Created by Alex for the community model (2026-11-13); every pull request is an agent's, acting for Alex. Alex asked for its development to be automated on 2026-11-14.
Created by Alex for the GrimoireLab Discord contribution Prism (2026-11-13). Its upstream PR to CHAOSS stays a human act (H1).
Alex's own repository; Alex is its only maintainer.

shared.why: The Foundation's organization defaults and GOVERNANCE.md. Alex, 2026-11-16: do not wait on Alex for merging; the controller merges agents' pull requests here on green, and a person's keeps its maintainers' review (AUTOMATION.md H4).

agents.why: Agents push as Alex's account from claude/ branches (AUTOMATION.md); a person's pull request comes from another account or branch

gatesWhy: The files that hold or enforce a human gate: H1 (outside), H2 (secrets), H3 (these gates) and the intervention people gate. A change to one needs a human, so no agent can remove a gate; every other trust-root change merges on green gates (Alex, 2026-11-14T21:36Z).
